notes.title: Daily Score Calculation Update (1.0.3)
notes.content:
This update changes how the daily's score is calculated. Here are the changes:

Daily Runs
[list]
[*] Daily Run score calculation has been updated to allow for a much larger range of values.
[*] This change will break previous daily leaderboards, but all future daily leaderboards will be more precise and allow better tracking of higher damage hands
[/list]

Bug Fixes
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where the ‘Buy 200 items’ unlock condition wasn’t being triggered
[*] Fixed a bug where boss ability sometimes targetted an invalid position
[*] Adjusted how Hurt triggers work to stop some infinites
[*] Fixed a bug where sometimes the camera would get stuck far away, making everything uninteractable
[*] Fixed an issue causing crashes when certain numbers are displayed
[*] Fixed an issue where certain banned relics could appear during certain Grades
[*] Grade 19 boss abilities now change every round
[*] Fixed a bug where Firefighter spawned a Firetruck with incorrect stats
[/list]

notes.title: Bug Fixes (v1.0.2c)
notes.content:
This is a small bug fix update that fixes some issues.

[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where won daily runs were not stored in Run History
[*] Fixed a bug where Clown ability was not working properly when copying certain abilities
[*] Fixed a bug where Grade 15 Candles were not unremovable
[*] Fixed a bug where Grade 16 item shop was not working properly
[*] Fixed a bug where sometimes pressing the daily run start button did nothing
[*] Fixed a bug with Skull on infinite speed
[*] Fixed a bug where enemy boss abilities on dailies sometimes targeted different positions
[/list]

notes.title: Infinite Fast Forward (1.0.2)
notes.content:
This update introduces a new fast forward option that allows you to quickly skip through the battle!


Fast Forwarding
[list]
[*] Revamped the fast forward UI
[*] Added a new fast forward option for infinite speed, which processes as many abilities as possible per frame
[/list]


General Improvements
[list]
[*] Attack and health text sizes will decrease if the number is large to try to prevent overlapping
[*] Swapped the ‘Stay’ and ‘Leave’ buttons on the confirmation popup that appears if you try to leave the shop with extra coins
[*] Adjusted a few card descriptions to be more readable
[*] Updated the projectile sprites that certain cards throw
[/list]


Bug Fixes
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where game was crashing on launch for some people
[*] Fixed a bug where Partying caused crashes with certain buffs
[/list]

notes.title: Balance Adjustments and Improvements (1.0.1)
notes.content:
Thanks to everyone for playing the game so far. This update brings some balance adjustments to certain cards, as well as some QoL improvements. Here is the full changelog:

Balancing:
[list]
[*] Enemy scaling past round 25 has been increased significantly
[*] Dog: Ability’s attack buff changed from 3*level → 4*level
[*] Monocle: Ability changed from giving experience to ally behind → random ally
[*] Teacher: Ability changed from Activated: Give xp to all allies → Hand Played: Give xp to all allies ahead
[/list]

General Improvements:
[list]
[*] Round header now displays total number of rounds needed for a win (25 rounds)
[*] Added a confirmation popup if you try to leave the shop when you haven’t spend all your coins
[*] You can now hover over the emojis in the Daily menu to see what each one does
[*] You can also hover over the emojis in the Continue Run UI
[*] A new button has been added to the shop during daily runs to see what cards are available in the daily
[*] Added a new achievement for dealing 1e9 damage in one hand
[*] Heat value now displays with comma separators and scientific notation
[/list]

Bug Fixes
[list]
[*] School relic now correctly gives +3 experience
[*] Fixed issue where a cards' unlock conditions were not triggering (Remove 20 cards)
[*] Fixed a cards' unlock condition description being incorrect (Trigger 100 buffs in one turn → Level a Sick up to Level 4)
[*] Fixed bug where Bronze Medal relic triggered on the 2nd to last hand rather than on the last hand
[*] Fixed incorrect Beach relic description
[*] Fixed bug where new relics wouldn’t appear after buying a frozen relic
[*] Fixed incorrect Grade 5 modifier description
[*] Fixed bug where Waving Hand relic allowed certain once-per-turn relics to trigger multiple times
[*] Fixed some incorrect achievements
[/list]

notes.title: Big Visual Revamp (0.4.0)
notes.content:
Happy New Year! Here are the changes for this update:

[h2]Massive Visual Overhaul[/h2]
The game has undergone a huge visual update. There are new backgrounds, transition animations, button visuals, card animations, sound effects, and more. Overall, it should hopefully look and feel much more satisfying than before.

[h2]System Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Summoning cards has a new animation
[*] Enemy [b]Hand Played[/b] abilities now trigger before Relic or Face [b]Hand Played[/b] abilities
[*] Ability processing logic has been tweaked slightly in regards to [b]Destroyed[/b] abilities
[/list]

[h2]Cards[/h2]
[list]
[*] Rat: Emoji has been changed. Summoned Mouse’s emoji has also been changed.
[*] Pig: Emoji has been changed
[*] Package: Golden ability changed from summoning 2 copies of the strongest card in deck → 1 golden copy of the strongest card in deck
[*] Flushed: Changed ability to: Increase health by 50/100/150% of base health
[*] Vampire: Changed ability to: Set health equal to 100/150/200% of the healthiest ally’s health
[/list]

[h2]Relics[/h2]
[list]
[*] Baseball: Removed
[*] 2 new Tier 3 Relics added
[/list]

[h2]Runes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Steak: Removed
[/list]


[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where certain cards were getting their icons cut off
[*] Some slight performance improvements when there are tons of summons
[*] Fixed an issue where run history times were incorrectly formatted
[*] Fixed a bug where runs could be continued past 25 rounds
[*] Fixed an issue where emojis had transparent pixels within the outline
[*] Fixed an issue where multiple Collection menu tabs could be visible at the same time
[*] Added compression effect to audio to reduce the volume of certain repeating sound effects
[/list]

notes.title: Stats Update (0.3.0)
notes.content:
It's been a while since the previous update! That's because I've been working on new stuff for the full release, so I hope you will look forward to it!

Anyways, I wanted to make another update for the demo to include some of the new stuff I've been working on recently. There's no new content in this update, but there's a ton of other changes! Read all about it below:

Note: Your settings will be reset to default with the new update. Sorry for any inconvenience.

[h2]Stats, Graphs, Run History[/h2]
[list]
[*] New, comprehensive stat tracking has been added!
[*] View your stats by pressing the "Stats" button via the menu button in the top right
[*] Contains general stats, various visualizations with bar graphs, and a run history where you can view your past runs!
[*] NOTE: Your stats in the demo version will not be carried over to the full version
[/list]

[h2]Collection[/h2]
[list]
[*] New collection menu has been added!
[*] View the collection by pressing the "Collection" button via the  menu button in the top right
[*] Contains information about all cards, relics, runes, and items in the game
[*] Also contains some stats about each card, like how often you buy each card
[/list]

[h2]New UI[/h2]
[list]
[*] The menu to start a new run has been updated. You can now see details about the current run in progress in this menu.
[*] The menu that appears at the end of a run has been completely overhauled!
[*] It is much more comprehensive, showing more stats and graphs about your run
[*] Added a new menu on the main menu where you can swap between 3 profiles. Each one stores its own stats, run history, etc.
[/list]

[h2]General[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added error messages that appear when you perform certain invalid actions (like trying to buy a card when you have 0 coins)
[*] Decklist window now shows 7 cards per row instead of 6
[*] Added a new animation ramp up toggle in the settings
[*] Added a new background warp toggle in the settings
[*] The background effect has been adjusted
[*] Added a slight wobbling animation to all cards
[*] Camera now zooms out when summoning more than 5 units (up to a certain amount)
[/list]

[h2]Gameplay[/h2]

[h3]General[/h3]
[list]
[*] Max rounds has been increased to 25
[*] Bosses now appear every 5 rounds instead of 4
[*] Enemy health has been increased
[*] Changed [b]Start of Turn[/b] keyword into [b]Hand Played[/b]
[*] Changed wording of card abilities that deal damage to the enemy. This is now referred to as "Shooting"
[*] Cost of relics has been decreased from 4 → 2
[*] Relic shop no longer rerolls automatically between rounds. Instead, you gain 1 progress towards the reroll
[*] Base stats of almost all cards has been adjusted
[*] Combining two golden cards now gives +2/+2 and +2 xp
[/list]

[h3]Cards[/h3]
[list]
[*] There were a ton of tweaks to card abilities. I can't list them all here, but give them a try!
[/list]

[h3]Relics[/h3]
[list]
[*] School: Tier 1 → 2
[*] School: Ability changed from giving +3 experience → +2 experience
[*] Tornado: Tier 1 → 2
[*] Slot Machine: Ability changed from increasing stats by 50% → 100%
[*] Firecracker: Changed ability to: Ally Destroyed: Deal 1 damage to the enemy. Card Removed: Increase this relic’s damage by 100% [200%] of its attack
[*] Candle: Ability now triggers golden abilities if the target is golden, even if Candle is not golden (this is also how Mechanic and Clown abilities work now too)
[*] Baby Bottle: Removed
[*] Satellite: Ability changed from giving 50% → 100%
[/list]

[h3]Runes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Skull: Tier 3 → 4
[*] Skull: Changed trigger condition from "Start of Turn" to "Activated"
[/list]

[h3]Items[/h3]
[list]
[*] Carrot: Tier 4 → 3
[*] Carrot: Effect changed from giving +3 health → +3 health and -1 attack
[/list]

[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where burned cards appeared above the decklist and discard pile panels during battle
[*] Fixed a bug with scrolling on higher refresh rates
[/list]

Thanks for reading / playing!!

notes.title: Relics Update (v0.2.0)
notes.content:
This update introduces a new system called [b]Relics[/b], an overhauled save system, visual changes, and more! Here are the changes:

[h2]Relics[/h2]
[list]
[*] A new system has been added called Relics
[*] Starting on round 5, you can buy relics from the shop
[*] Relics provide powerful bonuses to your hands and your run
[*] Relics cost 4 gold each and you can hold up to 3 Relics at once
[/list]

[h2]Visual Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] The background animation has been changed
[*] The transition animation has been changed
[/list]

[h2]Better Saving System[/h2]
[list]
[*] The save system has been overhauled and improved. It will now properly save your progress during battles and shops instead of only saving at the start of each.
[*] It also now properly preserves your deck order during battles, and the contents of the shop when you left.
[/list]

[h2]Automatic Fast Forward[/h2]
[list]
[*] When you are on 3x speed, the battle animations will automatically slowly ramp up in speed over time. This will not happen on 1x or 2x speed.
[*] This should reduce the time it takes for certain hands to play out.
[/list]

[h2]System Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] The change in the previous patch where unspent coins were carried over has been reverted. You will now lose any unspent coins upon entering the next shop.
[*] You can now merge cards even if they are level 3. It will gain the stats from merging as usual.
[/list]

[h2]Balance Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Enemy health has been increased
[*] Bow (enemy ability): Removed from the game
[*] Baby Bottle (enemy ability): Sprite and name changed from Baby Bottle → Reverse
[/list]

[h3]Items[/h3]
[list]
[*] Ribbon: Tier changed from 3 → 2
[*] Bouquet: Tier changed from 2 → 3
[*] Cake: Sprite and name changed from Cake → Cake Slice
[/list]

[h3]Cards[/h3]
[list]
[*] Package: Base stats changed from 3/3 → 2/2
[*] Package: Ability changed from summoning a 1/1, 3/3, 5/5 → 3/3, 6/6, 9/9
[*] Tropical Fish: Summoned Fish’s stats changed from 2/2, 5/5, 8/8 → 2/2, 6/6, 10/10
[*] Tropical Fish (Golden): Changed from summoning two 4/4, 10/10, 16/16 Fish → four 2/2, 6/6, 10/10 Fish
[*] Wind Face: Summoned Cloud stats changed from 2/2, 5/5, 8/8 → 2/2, 6/6, 10/10
[*] Clown: Ability now only copies non-Golden abilities of allies, even if ally is Golden.
[*] Clown (Golden): Ability changed from copy ability of ally ahead and ally behind as level 1/2/3 → copy ability of ally ahead as if it were level 1/2/3 and golden
[*] Mechanic: Ability now only triggers non-Golden abilities of allies, even if ally is Golden.
[*] Mechanic (Golden): Ability changed from triggering all ally Activated abilities as if they were level 1/2/3, twice → trigger all ally Activated abilities as if they were level 1/2/3, and golden
[*] Doctor: Ability changed from Ally Hurt: Give them +0/+1, +1/+1, +2/+1 → Ally Ahead Hurt: Give them +1/2/3 health
[/list]

[h3]Other[/h3]
[list]
[*] Shark: Should now properly eat Ghosts spawned from Tombstone
[*] Fixed a bug where Clown copying Zombie ability was not working properly
[/list]

notes.title: Golden Cards (Demo v0.1.0)
notes.content:
This new update introduces Golden cards, shop discounts, and some changes to the core systems.
Here are the patch notes for version 0.1.0 of the demo:

[h2]Golden Cards[/h2]
[list]
[*] New Golden cards have been added to the shop!
[*] You might rarely find Golden cards in the shop during your runs. Every card has a Golden variant, which has a significantly stronger ability!
[/list]

[h2]Shop Discounts[/h2]
[list]
[*] You might find discounted cards in the shop.
[*] Discounted cards only cost 1 gold instead of the usual 2.
[/list]

[h2]New Content[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added 3 new minions, 4 new runes, and 1 new item.
[*] Removed the Scared minion. It has been replaced with the new Scared rune.
[/list]

[h2]System Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Coins are now carried over between rounds. Any unspent coins will be kept, and can be spent in the next shop.
[*] The minimum deck size has been changed from 12 → 14. If you have less than 14 cards, the remaining slots will be filled with Poop.
[*] After playing a hand, the remaining cards in your hand will be discarded instead of kept. You will draw a fresh hand of 7 cards at the start of every turn.
[/list]

[h2]Balance Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Enemy health has been increased at later rounds
[*] Kissing: Ability changed from giving +1/+1, +2/+2, +3/+3 → +1/+1, +3/+3, +5/+5
[*] Dog: Ability changed from giving +2/4/6 attack → +2/5/8 attack
[*] Joy: Ability changed from giving +2/4/8 attack → +2/5/8 attack
[*] Heart Eyes: Ability changed from giving +2/4/8 health → +2/5/8 health
[*] Juggler: Ability changed from giving +2/+2, +3/+3, +4/+4 → +1/+1, +3/+3, +5/+5
[*] Snowman: Changed from tier 3 → 2
[*] Snowman: Base stats changed from 1/10 → 1/7
[*] Horse Rider: Summoned Horse stats changed from 7/7, 14/14, 21/21 → 10/10, 20/20, 30/30
[*] Shark: Ability changed from gaining summoned stats+0/1/2 → 50/100/150% of the summoned stats
[/list]

[h2]Infinite Combo Resolution[/h2]
[list]
[*] A resolution for infinite combos has been implemented. It works as follows:
[*] After the enemy attacks, if the target ally’s health either stays the same or increases, then the enemy gains +1 attack. This attack bonus resets once the ally is destroyed.
[/list]

[h2]Other[/h2]
[list]
[*] The Deck List and Discard Pile UI’s have been improved. They should no longer lag when your deck contains many cards. They also now update in real-time during combat as you draw or discard cards.
[*] The Deck List and Discard Pile UI’s now have smoother scrolling when scrolling with your mouse wheel.
[*] End of battle popup animation speed now scales based on your current selected time scale
[*] Various battle animations have been sped up
[*] Fixed a bug where excess gold amount was not saved properly when exiting and continuing a run
[/list]

If you have any feedback or suggestions, feel free to post them in the [url=https://discord.gg/rx8HrMmrBn]Discord[/url], or on the Steam forums.

notes.title: Runes Update (Demo v0.0.3)
notes.content:
Thanks as always to everyone playing the demo! If you missed it, there’s a Discord server for if you want to talk about the game or suggest ideas and stuff: [url=https://discord.gg/rx8HrMmrBn]https://discord.gg/rx8HrMmrBn[/url]

Anyways, here are the changes for this update:

[h2]Rune System[/h2]
A new type of item has been added into the item shop pool called Runes. Runes are items that are attached to cards, and they provide additional abilities or effects to the card. One rune can be attached to each card in your deck. There are currently a few runes in each tier, and there are plans to add many more in the future.


[h2]New Cards[/h2]
8 brand new cards have been added into the shop. Try them out :-)


[h2]General Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Added a ‘Skip’ button that appears once the enemy falls below 0 health. Press it to skip viewing the remaining combat, and move on to the next phase immediately.
[*]The ‘Banish’ button in the shop has been removed. Instead, banishing cards is now done from the decklist view. Right click a card in this menu to remove it from your deck.
[*]You now gain 1 additional coin per extra hand you had at the end of combat to spend in the next shop.
[*]A new popup will appear at the end of each battle to show this information.
[*]The formula for stat gained from merging two cards has been adjusted. It now considers the xp of the merged units instead of always giving +1/+1.
[/list]

[h2]Enemy Boss Ability Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Enemy ability Microbe has been removed
[*]Enemy ability Chemical has been changed from setting an enemy’s health to 1 → setting an enemy’s attack and health to 1
[*]Enemy ability Scissors has been changed from dealing damage to the strongest enemy (equal to the current round) → dealing damage to all enemies (equal to current attack)
[/list]

[h2]Card Balancing[/h2]
[list]
[*]Package ability changed from summoning a random card from your entire deck → summoning the strongest card from your entire deck
[*]Flushed base stats changed from 2/4 → 3/3
[*]Flushed ability changed from gain 50/100/150% health → 33/66/100% health
[*]Vampire ability no longer considers its own health
[*]Monkey changed from tier 2 → 3
[*]Monkey base stats changed from 2/2 → 4/4
[*]Snowman ability changed from setting attack equal to 100/150/200% of health → 100/200/300% of health
[*]Tombstone - summoned Ghost stats changed from 2/2, 4/4, 6/6 → 3/3, 6/6, 9/9
[*]Witch - ability changed from giving 33/66/100% of attack → 50/100/150% of attack
[/list]

[h2]Other[/h2]
[list]
[*]Updated the visuals of various UI elements
[*]Card descriptions can now appear below the card if there is not enough space above.
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug where loading a run would keep frozen units saved
[*]Fixed a bug causing xp to be incorrect when loading a saved run
[*]Fixed an issue where mouse position was incorrectly calculated at resolutions other than 1920x1080
[/list]

:-)

notes.title: Demo Update (0.0.2)
notes.content:
Hey, thanks to everyone who tried out the demo so far!
First of all, I opened up a little Discord, so hop in if you want to talk about the game: [url=https://discord.gg/rx8HrMmrBn]https://discord.gg/rx8HrMmrBn[/url]
In addition, I've made some changes that you can read about below:

[list]
[*]The game's save directory has been changed. This means your settings will be reset, and you will encounter the tutorial again. You will also lose your current run progress. Sorry for any inconvenience!
[/list]

[h2]Enemy Adjustments[/h2]
[list]
[*]Every 4 rounds, you will encounter a boss with a special ability.
[*]Enemy attack and health scaling have been updated.
[*]The default enemy sprite has been changed. The old sprite is now used as the boss enemy sprite.
[/list]

[h2]Quality of Life[/h2]
[list]
[*]Added the ability to move and re-arrange cards on the battlefield by dragging and dropping.
[*]Added a 3x speed option.
[*]Added a section in the shop showing the upcoming enemy.
[*]Added a popup showing the shop's probability rates when hovering over the "Shop" header.
[*]Ability chaining logic has been reworked to fix certain combos.
[/list]

[h2]Balance Changes[/h2]

[h3]General[/h3]
[list]
[*]XP required for level 2 has been decreased from 3 -> 2
[*]Banishing cards cost has been reduced from 2 -> 0
[/list]

[h3]Items[/h3]
[list]
[*]Apple item has been removed
[*]Broccoli item has been removed
[*]Avocado item has been removed
[*]Carrot item has been changed from tier 2 -> 4
[*]Carrot effect changed from giving -1/+3 -> +3 health
[*]Pear effect changed from giving +2/+2 -> +2/+1
[*]Watermelon effect changed from giving +3/+3 -> +4/+1
[/list]

[h3]Cards[/h3]
[list]
[*]Mind Blown ability changed from Activated: Deal 5/10/20 damage -> Hurt: Deal 4/8/12 damage
[*]Sick ability changed from dealing 100/150/200% attack damage -> 100/200/300% attack damage
[*]Weight Lifter ability changed from gaining +1/+1, +2/+2, +3/+3 -> +2/4/8 attack
[*]Juggler ability changed from giving +1/+1, +2/+2, +4/+4 -> +2/+2, +3/+3, +4/+4
[*]Fairy ability changed from giving +2/+2, +3/+3, +4/+4 -> +2/+2, +4/+4, +6/+6
[*]Raccoon ability changed from gaining +1/2/4 attack -> +1/3/5 attack
[*]Present ability changed from giving 100/150/200% stats -> 50/100/150% stats
[*]Present base stats changed from 3/3 -> 4/2
[*]Package ability changed from summon a 1/1 at all levels -> summon a 1/1, 3/3, 5/5
[*]Goofy ability changed from dealing damage 1/2/3 times -> 2/4/6 times
[*]Tropical Fish ability changed from summoning two 2/2, 4/4, 6/6 Fish -> two 2/2, 5/5, 8/8 Fish
[*]Flamingo base stats changed from 1/4 -> 1/5
[*]Wind Face ability changed from summoning a 2/2, 4/4, 6/6 Cloud -> 2/2, 5/5, 8/8 Cloud
[*]Skunk ability changed from dealing damage 1/2/3 times -> 2/4/6 times
[*]Snowman base stats changed from 1/8 -> 1/10
[*]Zombie base stats changed from 4/1 -> 5/1
[*]Love Letter ability changed from giving +4/8/12 health -> +5/10/15 health
[/list]

[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug where merging gave more stats that intended sometimes
[/list]

As always, thanks for playing!
